name: Mazomai ~M na Imouto no Ecchi na Onedari~
original_name: まぞまい　M な妹のエッチなおねだり
source:
The protagonist, Kusuno Takumi, lost his parents 10 years ago and has been raising his three younger sisters on his own.

He and his siblings live a modest life together, running the coffee shop that his parents left to him.

One day, while cleaning his parents' room, whose hobby was collecting antiques, he finds a milk pot with a cute fairy painted on it.

He thinks it's something suspicious, since his father likes the occult,
but his sisters seem to like it and immediately start preparing milk tea.

Then, something strange happens to the sisters who drink the milk tea.

They suddenly approach the protagonist and start begging him to do naughty things.

And it's not just naughty, they ask him to bully them.

The protagonist is confused because he can't bully his precious sisters.
But the sisters ask their beloved brother to bully them.

Then the erotic and silly daily life of the brother who can't bully his precious sisters and the sisters who want their brother to bully them begins! !

Translated from https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009244.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F
translation:
主角楠野拓海在10年前失去父母，此后独自抚养三个妹妹。

他和妹妹们过着朴素生活，经营父母留下的咖啡馆。

一天，他在清理父母的房间时发现了一个牛奶壶。父母喜欢收藏古董，壶上画着可爱的妖精。

父亲喜欢神秘学，他觉得这东西很可疑，
但妹妹们似乎很喜欢，立刻开始准备奶茶。

喝下奶茶后，妹妹们发生了奇怪变化。

她们突然靠近主角，央求他做下流的事。

还不只是下流，她们要求他欺负自己。

主角感到困惑，因为他无法欺负珍爱的妹妹。
但妹妹们请求心爱的哥哥欺负她们。

无法欺负珍爱妹妹的哥哥，与想让哥哥欺负自己的妹妹之间，情色又愚蠢的日常生活开始了！！
